# Leafkin Druid: "{T}: Add {G}. / If you control four or more creatures, add {G}{G} instead."
# "X. If cond, Y instead." is Conditional(pred=cond, then_effect=Y, else_effect=X) (Life Goes On, Lofty Denial, Cinderclasm).
mana = ActivatedAbility(
    cost=Cost(parts=(CostTap(),)),
    effect=Conditional(
        pred=FAtom(
            pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_COUNT_GE,
            count=QConst(value=4),
            inner_filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
        ),
        then_effect=A(Verb.ADD_MANA, {'amount': QConst(value=2), 'color': 'G', 'controller': ControllerRef.YOU}),
        else_effect=A(Verb.ADD_MANA, {'amount': QConst(value=1), 'color': 'G', 'controller': ControllerRef.YOU}),
    ),
)
abilities = [mana, compiled[1]]

clauses.clause: If you control four or more creatures, add {G}{G} instead.
